diagnostics.observed: Combining a responsive viewport override with native fullscreen produced a clipped screenshot composite. Default native fullscreen was verified separately without that override. The cause was not established; this diagnostic is not included among accepted screenshots.

rendering: True WebGL 3D presentation over original x/z planar flight rules; asteroids and ambient traffic are decorative, with no collision combat or six-degree-of-freedom flight.
